SLA 策略对之后新建 / 重新计算时限的工单生效，请确认下面的变更：: The SLA policy applies to workflows created or recalculated from now on. Review the changes below:
为还没有采集配置的实例生成默认配置，默认停用；已有配置的实例保持不变。: Generate default configs for instances that have none. They are disabled by default; instances that already have a config are left unchanged.
你只有“查看配置”权限，{what}为只读。: You only have the "view configuration" permission, so {what} is read-only.
修复前基线：平均 {avg} ms，日均浪费 {daily} s。: Baseline before fix: avg {avg} ms, {daily} s wasted per day.
修复前日均浪费 DB 时间: Daily DB time wasted before fix
修复后已观察 {days} 天，没有再出现。: Observed for {days} days after the fix; it has not reappeared.
修复后已观察 {days} 天：平均 {avg} ms（{avgPct}），日均: Observed for {days} days after the fix: avg {avg} ms ({avgPct}), {daily} s wasted per day ({dailyPct}).
修复后的观察数据要从修复次日起累计（已观察 0 天，自动验证需要 {n} 天）。: Post-fix data is collected from the day after the fix (0 days observed; auto-verification needs {n} days).
修改团队配置与路由规则: Modify team config and routing rules
关闭后再出现也不会自动重开。: It will not be reopened automatically if it reappears after closing.
关闭后，同一 SQL（同实例 + 库 + 指纹）再次出现也不会重开工单。: After closing, the workflow will not be reopened when the same SQL (same instance + database + fingerprint) reappears.
删除后命中该规则的新工单按后续规则分派。: After deletion, new workflows that matched this rule are assigned by the remaining rules.
删除后该团队不再接收自动分派；资源组与已有工单不受影响。: After deletion, this team no longer receives automatic assignments. The resource group and existing workflows are not affected.
删除后该实例不再被自动采集；已经建好的工单不受影响。: After deletion, this instance is no longer collected automatically. Existing workflows are not affected.
升级通知对象暂时只能使用默认值（未执行 060_perf_ext.sql）。: Escalation notification targets can only use the defaults for now (060_perf_ext.sql has not been run).

同意后工单关闭，仅影响升到 P0 才会自动重开。: After approval the workflow is closed; it reopens automatically only if its level rises to P0.
